name: 27-train-for-misty
objective: Train the lead in Route 4's grass, east of Mt Moon, until it is level 24 - the level at which the Squirtle line first holds a move that beats Misty's STARMIE.
evidence: watch:lead_level>=24 - wPartyMon1Level $D18C, offset 33 into the 44-byte party_struct at wPartyMons $D16B. The atlas records the address and the drill links already read it.

24 IS READ OFF THE CARTRIDGE AND IT IS THE SQUIRTLE LINE'S NUMBER. Misty's party from TrainerDataPointers (0E:5D3B, class 35) is STARYU Lv18 and STARMIE Lv21, both WATER and STARMIE also PSYCHIC. Their movesets, built by WriteMonMoves from the base-stats moves plus the learnset up to the level, are TACKLE + WATER GUN and TACKLE + WATER GUN + HARDEN - so the only threat is a 40-power special WATER move. Against that: the BULBASAUR line holds VINE WHIP from level 13 and is 2x on both, and wins from level 18; the SQUIRTLE line resists WATER but has nothing better than a 35-power TACKLE until WARTORTLE learns BITE (60 power) at level 24, which is exactly where the race flips; the CHARMANDER line is 2x weak to WATER GUN and has no answer at any level. 24 is where all three lines are as strong as they will get by grinding, which is the same shape link 15's 16 has.

ROUTE 4'S GRASS IS A CLOSED ROOM WITH ONE DOOR, AND IT IS ON THE ROAD THE CHAIN ALREADY WALKS. Sixty walkable tiles at x=64-73, y=10-15 - the tileset's own grass tile $52, read out of the block map - walled at row 9 and row 16 and at x=62 and x=75, entered only along row 14 through x=75-77. There is no trainer in the room and no ledge inside it, so a patrol between (64,10) and (73,15) stays on grass for every step.

WHY HERE AND NOT SOMEWHERE RICHER. Experience per step, computed from WildDataPointers and BaseStats' base-experience byte: Route 4 7.55, Route 5 8.10, Route 24 10.85, Route 25 6.33, Mt Moon B2F 3.86, Route 3 4.22. Route 5's grass is behind a one-way ledge descent - rows 3, 7, 11 and 15 are LedgeTiles entries, so the patches can be dropped into and never climbed back out of - and Route 24's is on the far side of Nugget Bridge's five trainers plus a ROCKET. Route 4 is 7% behind the best of the three and needs neither.

A BLACKOUT IS A LEGAL DETOUR AND NOT A FAILURE, so party_hp=0 is not on the failure list. Link 26 has already moved the anchor to Cerulean, so waking up costs the walk back across one city rather than the whole mountain.
